(For example, equipment must sometimes be brought into fragile ecosystems or new microorganisms or chemicals are introduced into the environment.) NEBA calculates the gains that can be expected from a given response strategy - e.g., the amount of oil removed, improvements to the ecosystem, etc. - minus the environmental injuries caused by the spill and response activities. This analytical tool allows spill-response managers to weigh the comparative effectiveness of -- and trade-offs associated with -- all available spill response options, including the "no action" or "natural biodegradation" options
